alterations.description: Delete shots showing the sahukar shivering, men armed with axes and spears about to attack, and a man in white pacifying the mob; omit any suggestion of violence in the commentary.
Curtail drastically the scene where Beli and then Kamo are whipped by Munshi, showing only one or two strokes.
Omit part of the scene showing Beli sitting with his back bearing marks of severe whipping.
Curtail somewhat the hand of the wounded Kamo showing blood dripping from it.
Delete the policeman's words to Raimi: 'If you are here again I will break your leg'.
Delete the close-up shot of the lady singer swooning and falling backwards upon Ramu.

Delete the sequence of the peon stealing from the iron safe, the durwan discovering and threatening him, his sharing the spoils with the durwan and cheating the latter, leaving only a suggestion at the start to establish the theft.
Delete Rupa's words 'Damn it'.

Delete Ramu being addressed by Singam inside the jail as 'God' (Kadavul) and the use of that term as a proper name when speaking to Ramu, except at the beginning where Singam says Ramu is venerated by him as God. Also delete in Reel-16 where Ramu takes leave of Singam.
Delete the appearances of persons in Indian Naval uniform in the drama at the club anniversary, except for their disembarkation from the ship and their departure.
Delete the shot of the photograph chosen by Rupa for the doctor and the close-up shots of Rupa’s bust after she and Rajee are separated by the doctor up to where she says 'I love you doctor'.
Delete Vasantasena telling Mallni 'I am the Maharaja’s bed' (sound only).
Delete the picture of the dancer in close up during the first verse of song-2.
In song-7 delete the last verse with picturisation from the words 'Yes, what do you say must be done now'.
In song No. 7 delete the references to Vasantasena as 'Ramaswami doota' and 'Hanuman' (sound only).
In the rehearsal of Vasantasena’s durbar, delete Malini being pulled by hand.

Delete Ugrssena telling Malini 'Do you think bhakti marga is going to be expounded here now' and Vasantasena telling Ugrasena 'Why do you look at me as if you are going to eat me' with accompanying picturisation in each case.
Cut out all the drink sauces and the toast.
Reduce the second kiss on the bench before the wedding.
Delete the sentence 'This is your turn Sir,' addressed to the Professor.
Close-up shot from below at the edge of the bathing pool (skirts swirling up).
Reduce to the minimum shots of Danny being punched whilst standing against the post of the ring.
Insert a tablet in Hindi to the effect that the story of the film relates to the pre-independence era.
Shot of Shekhar actually snatching the necklace from the lady.
The scene showing Shekhar's escape from custody of the police in the car.
Banke's words as spoken to the policemen 'Bade aaye police ke dum' and the picking out of the handkerchief from latter's pocket.
Banke's words 'Aur main bhi koi kiraye ki sarkar utha laoong' spoken while pointing to the statue of a female.
The flash-back of Chandrashekhar Azad being tortured (as seen by him in memory).
The sabotage of the Railway train.
Torturing of Chandrashekhar Azad in the jail to the minimum.
Chandrashekhar’s attack on postman, especially the part where the impression is of the postman having been killed.
Considerably all scenes of third-degree tortures from the picture.
The sequence of Chandrashekhar Azad and Didi with Mr. Scott.
The scene showing Chandrashekhar Azad robbing a postman.
The scene showing in silhouette three corpses hanging by the ropes, after Bhagat Singh and his two companions were hanged.
Picture of Rajan’s blood stained hand in close-up.
Delete the same shot where it occurs in Reel No. 13.
Insert pictures of the police inspector reacting, when he is interviewing Usha.
Detective's remarks about proper dress and improper actions.
In the park sequence, delete Ambujam's statement that it is her family occupation to remain waiting.
Detective’s remarks about the new truth he had discovered, about the various named religions, and the similarity in the facts of the case investigated.
Consequential reference in the police-station.
Consequential reference to 'Andha Kadavul' (The word 'Andha'— Sound only removed; modification approved).

Picture of slogans written on the wall, when the camera is focussed on them. Delete the entire sequence, sound and picture from the time the song 'Maugu Pennasai' is heard off-screen, including the interrogation of the priest, the insert picture of his wife, the remarks of the detective, when young girls pass on the street, up to and including the priest pointing to Shanmugham and saying that 'the latter was the go-between for that house'.
Reduce the sound of Chinniah’s choking and hiccup.
Delete Rajan’s remark with accompanying picture 'I shall remain here looking after the vessels'.

Delete the picture and speech of Rajan about the collections for fund, and his asking Pottai to shake the collection box, up to and including his remark that 'that there is no limit to the number of such collections'.
Delete Rajan’s remarks about 'fasting for many days without achieving anything'.
Delete the statement that 'thought had been devoted at Kasi and Ranchi'.
Delete the remarks of Rajan to Usha, 'if your God had eyes, he was also going to see'.
Delete the detective and the Inspector lifting their hats off and telling Usha that though they had to arrest her by way of duty for the murder, they could not but pay homage to her.
The scene showing Mohama’s expression of bust as Naren advances towards her and their consequent embrace, eliminating the shot showing Naren bolting the door.
Storm shots.
Portion of the scene between Narendra and father when former apologises to latter and seeks permission to retire to village.

All scenes of mob violence and arson on the part of un-Aryans, including burning of cottages of Rishis and slaughter of Rishis. The savage treatment meted out by Valmiki to his guru, culminating in the latter’s murder at the hands of his former devoted disciple.
